title: English and Scottish clubs in Europa League finals
brief: Name the ten English and Scottish clubs that have played in a UEFA Cup or Europa League final since 2000/01, ranked by finals played. Clubs level on finals are ordered by their first final.
period: UEFA Cup and Europa League finals, 2001 to 2026

notes.Arsenal: Arsenal also lost the 2000 final to Galatasaray, the season before this board starts.
notes.Spurs: Spurs also won the UEFA Cup in 1972 and 1984, before this board starts.
notes.Ipswich: Ipswich won the UEFA Cup in 1981, long before this board starts.
notes.Dundee United: Dundee United lost the 1987 final, before this board starts.
notes.Wolves: Wolves lost the first UEFA Cup final in 1972, before this board starts.
notes.Newcastle: Newcastle have not reached a UEFA Cup or Europa League final.
notes.West Ham: West Ham have not reached a UEFA Cup or Europa League final; they won the Conference League in 2023.
notes.Leicester: Leicester have not reached a UEFA Cup or Europa League final.

sources: https://match.uefa.com/v5/matches?competitionId=14 (UEFA's match feed, the final of each season)
checks: Every final from 2001 to 2026 in uel_finals.csv, checked on Wikipedia's list of finals and UEFA's match feed; these are all the English and Scottish finalists in that time, exactly ten clubs.
